title: Automation As Mycelium
definition: The concept of automation as a network of interconnected tools and processes that sustain and support the growth of a project or organization.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A network of automated tools that work together to help a project grow and thrive, like the roots of a forest.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A metaphorical view of automation as a living organism that supports and sustains a project, providing essential services and resources.
difficulty_levels.expert: A philosophical perspective that sees automation as an integral part of the project ecosystem, with its own identity and purpose.

extra_fields.insight: The novel realization that automation should be seen as an extension of the project, with its own life and purpose within the ecosystem.
